semantics: Literal DNS labels and hyphen-delimited tokens only. Tags describe candidate themes, never maliciousness. No queries are generated from this list.

sources.roadmap: ROADMAP.md: Phase 3 Domain monitoring detail, reviewed 2026-11-27

groups.name: Enrollment and Recovery
groups.basis: Vocabulary from reported enrollment/recovery and support impersonation. Only passkey is explicitly described there as a domain string; the other tokens are local detection hypotheses.

groups.name: Legal Theme
groups.basis: Reported legal-target, legaldept-target, target-legal and target.legal patterns. Never synthesize or query those names.

groups.name: IAM and MFA Brands
groups.basis: Roadmap seed vocabulary. Not a claim that every listed brand appeared in either report. Never added as watches automatically.

groups.name: Auth Flow
groups.basis: Roadmap hypotheses retained as exact-token tags, not evidence of an observed campaign.

rules.meaning: A full authorized domain appears as a contiguous sequence of hostname labels.
An explicitly authorized organization or brand token equals a complete DNS label.
An explicitly authorized organization or brand token equals a complete hyphen-delimited token within a DNS label.
An exact seed match co-occurs with an exact theme token anywhere in the hostname. This is annotation, not an extra match or a verdict.
